title: Virtual desktop pager should use a compact button for each desktop when "show window outlines" is off
line: With window outlines turned off, the Pager shows each desktop as a small square instead of a screen-shaped rectangle.
explanation: The Pager always sized each desktop with the screen's aspect ratio, even when window outlines are hidden and the desktops are just click targets, so on wide screens it took a lot of panel space. The widget now uses a square size for each desktop when window outlines are off, unless desktop names are shown (names need the wider cell). Window geometry scaling for outlines is unchanged.

commits.message:
applets/pager: make desktops square when window outlines are hidden

Without window outlines the desktops are only click targets, yet they
kept the shape of the screen and wasted panel space on wide screens. Use
square desktops in that case, unless they show desktop names.

BUG: 503245

patches.diff:
From 769eea7de58db0bc76db121ab5449f45f52302b3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:59:04 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/pager: make desktops square when window outlines are
 hidden

Without window outlines the desktops are only click targets, yet they
kept the shape of the screen and wasted panel space on wide screens. Use
square desktops in that case, unless they show desktop names.

BUG: 503245
---
 applets/pager/qml/main.qml | 10 +++++++---
 1 file changed, 7 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
index b4211ddbbd..0ae4001bea 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
@@ -27,9 +27,13 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     readonly property bool isActivityPager: Plasmoid.pluginName === "org.kde.plasma.activitypager"
     readonly property bool vertical: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
 
-    readonly property real aspectRatio: (((pagerModel.pagerItemSize.width * pagerItemGrid.effectiveColumns)
+    // Without window outlines desktops are only click targets: make them square unless they show names
+    readonly property size pagerItemSize: Plasmoid.configuration.showWindowOutlines || Plasmoid.configuration.displayedText === 1
+        ? pagerModel.pagerItemSize : Qt.size(pagerModel.pagerItemSize.height, pagerModel.pagerItemSize.height)
+
+    readonly property real aspectRatio: (((root.pagerItemSize.width * pagerItemGrid.effectiveColumns)
         + ((pagerItemGrid.effectiveColumns * pagerItemGrid.spacing) - pagerItemGrid.spacing))
-        / ((pagerModel.pagerItemSize.height * pagerItemGrid.effectiveRows)
+        / ((root.pagerItemSize.height * pagerItemGrid.effectiveRows)
         + ((pagerItemGrid.effectiveRows * pagerItemGrid.spacing) - pagerItemGrid.spacing)))
 
     Layout.minimumWidth: !root.vertical ? Math.floor(height * aspectRatio) : 1
@@ -286,7 +290,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             return Math.ceil(pagerModel.count / effectiveRows);
         }
 
-        readonly property real pagerItemSizeRatio: pagerModel.pagerItemSize.width / pagerModel.pagerItemSize.height
+        readonly property real pagerItemSizeRatio: root.pagerItemSize.width / root.pagerItemSize.height
         readonly property real widthScaleFactor: columnWidth / pagerModel.pagerItemSize.width
         readonly property real heightScaleFactor: rowHeight / pagerModel.pagerItemSize.height
 
--
